mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT log.uuid) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN geo.country_code IS NOT NULL THEN geo.country_code END) AS country_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN geo.geo_level = 2 THEN geo.id END) AS city_count FROM visit_log log LEFT JOIN visitor_geo geo ON geo.id = log.geo_id WHERE
SELECT geo.country_code, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT log.uuid) AS uv FROM visit_log log JOIN visitor_geo geo ON geo.id = log.geo_id WHERE GROUP BY geo.country_code ORDER BY uv DESC, pv DESC

SELECT geo.geo_key, geo.city_name_zh, geo.city_name_en, geo.region_name, geo.country_code, geo.latitude AS lat, geo.longitude AS lng, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT log.uuid) AS uv FROM visit_log log JOIN visitor_geo geo ON geo.id = log.geo_id AND geo.geo_level = 2 WHERE GROUP BY geo.id, geo.geo_key, geo.city_name_zh, geo.city_name_en, geo.region_name, geo.country_code, geo.latitude, geo.longitude ORDER BY uv DESC, pv DESC
